description: One unit→UOM mapping row for Connector Settings (spec 006, FR-008 Option A). Maps a Data-Pulse-2 free-text unit to an ERPNext UOM. Consumed by connector.posting.config.parse_uom_map (fieldnames dp2_unit/erpnext_uom must match the parser).

fields.label: DP2 Unit
fields.description: The Data-Pulse-2 free-text SaleLine.unit (e.g. 'each', 'kg'). Case-sensitive — no normalization.

fields.label: ERPNext UOM
fields.description: The ERPNext UOM this unit maps to (e.g. 'Nos', 'Kg').

name: RT Uom Map Row
